issue.title: Relation card can commit a previous label while new suggestions are pending
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-aj (land agent; neither phase proposed this). In bob-mac-capture bf40f48, updateRelationLabelPromptLabel preserves old suggestions while starting an asynchronous fetch; submitRelationLabelPrompt then unconditionally selects the first typed candidate, without checking it matches authoredLabel. The response handler also checks only draftSnapshot, not the authored label/request generation or prompt identity. Git blame traces both behaviors to a85b1f86 (closed bob-cli-a2), not aj. Independent portable reproduction extracts the production update/submit methods, stubs a still-pending fetch and the AppKit output sink, seeds typed old, updates to new, then submits: authored=new; committed=|old. This is an extracted-method reproduction, not a macOS UI run. Evidence attached. Fix the request/result identity and invalidate or gate stale candidates; ensure submit uses Bob-authored replacement for the current input. Add delayed/out-of-order response and immediate-Return regressions; compile according to linked AGENTS.md. Searched bug and all-type tasks and weekly sweeps; no semantic duplicate, no active causally related epic.

task_type_fields.impact: Relation labels can silently differ from what the user just authored; late older responses can also replace current validation and suggestions.
task_type_fields.repro: Run the attached Swift harness with swift: it prints authored=new; committed=|old. In app: type old and wait for its typed candidate, change to new, press Return before the new completion response arrives. It inserts |old.

issue.creation_reason: Found independently by the bob-cli-aj land audit while checking realistic relation-label completion fixtures. The stale-candidate logic predates this epic, so it needs a separate focused fix.
